Intro: My only rival. We meet again. My fifty-fourth dish, Le Rat Bourguignon, is so close to completion, but lately there's been a problem.
Something wrong with these streets. It's like the rats can sense it. More spoiled folk walking amongst us. A war brewing with hope of revolution.
And those monsters. The one's far too gone with Spoilage. They are growing, and they are getting braver.
The rats don't want to come out, and I can see why. I advise you stay safe, rival. Our feud must be settled.
Success: You do not disappoint. You would not be my rival for anything less. Till we meet again, dear rival.
Fail: Now don't get all scared from my stories. We still have a feud to settle. No spoiled ones can stop that.
Reject: You rotten rival. You think having Svetka handle your competition makes you a good chef? One day, justice will come, and you will see those shackles yourself!
